description: NaCrCSO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.87 Å. Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.11 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.23-1.34 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-45°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.50 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cr and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one S atom.
